description: Front B (broad catalog), O11 Reactive: the REFUSAL of the rename of a system event. In O11 11.55.69 ISystemEvent inherits a writable Name from IFlowSignature (kernel/catalog/model-api-11.55.69.json), but the event is a fixed place of the module (OnApplicationReady): the rename is refused by the platform. Measured in probe B-009 phase 1 (2026-09-24, O11 CLI e8cac2f7): "op #14 (rename CatBOnReady): InvalidOperationException: Cannot find handler for object OnApplicationReady of type On Application Ready.". Since 2026-10-03 the kernel translates that refusal from the NameClashHandler of the platform into a short sentence ("has a fixed name; the Studio does not rename it"). In ODC the rename of an ISystemEvent is also refused (tests/jobs-odc/platform-events-lifecycle.json). The system event is created by the first ISystemEvent factory of the IESpace (CreateOnApplicationReady, measured in tests/jobs/cat-b-app-events.json) with a minimal valid body.
expectError: rename: ISystemEvent 'OnApplicationReady' has a fixed name; the Studio does not rename it
